worker.auth_token_file.description: Optional absolute path to a file containing an OAuth2 bearer token for authenticating to the Debusine server

worker.docker.description: Optional Docker daemon configuration (set if using containerized builds)

host.description: Docker daemon connection URL (unix socket or TCP)

worker.environment.description: Optional key-value pairs of environment variables passed to each build task

worker.listen.host.description: Network interface to bind the worker HTTP server to

worker.listen.port.description: Port number for the worker HTTP server

worker.logging.file.description: Absolute path to log file (use '-' to log to stdout)

worker.logging.level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

worker.max_concurrent_tasks.description: Maximum number of build tasks this worker can execute simultaneously

worker.resource_limits.cpus.description: Maximum CPU cores (or fractional cores) allowed per build task

worker.resource_limits.memory_mb.description: Maximum memory in MB allowed per build task

worker.server.url.description: Base URL of the Debusine server this worker registers with

worker.server.verify_tls.description: If true, verify TLS certificates when connecting to the Debusine server

worker.task_timeout.description: Time in seconds after which a build task is considered failed (0 = no timeout)

worker.tls_ca_path.description: Optional absolute path to a CA bundle file for verifying the Debusine server's TLS certificate

worker.workdir.description: Absolute path to the directory where build outputs and logs are stored

worker_id.description: A unique string identifier for this worker (e.g., 'laptop-01' or 'ci-node-7')
